note: v4 -- supersedes v3's Index/Drivers/Journey/screener content, sourced from Youth-Collab-Survey-Augmented_F.docx (the 'working draft' pairing an Engaged branch with a parallel Unengaged branch for respondents who don't identify as followers of Jesus). Changes from v3: (1) Screener: 'orientation' gains 'none_of_these' and 'prefer_not_say' options; a new optional 'follower_check' item routes those two answers (stores routing separately from stated identity, per the draft's own implementation note -- 'not sure'/'prefer not to say' on follower_check route to Unengaged without asserting confirmed non-follower status). (2) The old 12-item unscored 'exploration' branch (explore_believe_god etc., v0-v3) is RETIRED in v4 -- archived in v0-v3, not deleted -- replaced by a full 24-item Unengaged Index using the SAME 3x4 domain x tier cells and the same internal/external measure pairing as the Engaged Index, tagged branch:'unengaged'. (3) SCORING DECISION (explicit, researcher-approved, not inferred from the draft): despite sharing the matrix shape, Unengaged responses are NEVER blended into the official Index. They compute a fully separate 'Exploration Index' (src/lib/scoring.ts: explorationIndex/explorationTiers/explorationDomains/explorationMatrix, mirrored in the SQL functions via responses.branch) -- the draft itself says 'it does not make the scores equivalent.' Dashboards must never sum or average the two together. (4) Drivers and Journey each gain a parallel Unengaged variant (still fully unscored, non-negotiable #9) with branch-appropriate wording/options from the draft; continue_to_extras is now unconditional (offered to both branches, not just Engaged). (5) gender is REINSTATED (session_field, new sessions.gender column) after being dropped in v3.1's privacy/approved-metadata review (migration 0019) -- explicit decision for v4, not a silent reversal; flagged here for the record. city/area is ADDED (session_field, new sessions.city column, free text) per the current project non-negotiable #1, which requires a CITY-LEVEL critical-mass gate (not just country) precisely because this field is free text and could otherwise identify a small town -- that gate is schema/config-ready but the analytics enforcement (mirroring 0020's country-tier gate) is not yet built; flagged as follow-up, same posture as the existing benchmarking-service gap. (6) pray_frequency/scripture_frequency are kept verbatim, scored:false, Engaged-only -- CLAUDE.md #5's 'always measurable' requirement is still met the same way v3.2 met it; the draft still doesn't offer a frequency-anchored item for either activity on its own, and that gap is flagged again here for researchers, per non-negotiable #5, rather than silently invented. (7) KNOWN EDGE CASE: a respondent who answers orientation as none_of_these/prefer_not_say and then SKIPS follower_check sees neither Index branch (both gates require an answer; an unanswered gate never passes, per branching.ts's existing leak-prevention design) -- same conservative default every other gated item in this instrument already has, not a new limitation introduced by this version, but worth a product decision if drop-off there turns out to matter. Subject to researcher revision -- never hard-code into UI or scoring.

text.en: How do you feel about talking with Christians about religion or belief? Check all that apply.
text.es: ¿Cómo te sientes al hablar con cristianos sobre religión o creencias? Marca todas las que correspondan.

text.en: I talk about it naturally.
text.es: Hablo de ello con naturalidad.

text.en: I talk about it mainly with people I am close to.
text.es: Hablo de ello principalmente con personas cercanas a mí.

text.en: I am open to talking about it when it feels relevant to my life.
text.es: Estoy abierto/a a hablar de ello cuando siento que es relevante para mi vida.

text.en: I usually wait to be asked about it.
text.es: Normalmente espero a que me pregunten.

text.en: I avoid it because I want to keep relationships comfortable.
text.es: Lo evito porque quiero mantener relaciones cómodas.

text.en: I worry about offending people.
text.es: Me preocupa ofender a las personas.

text.en: I am not sure how to bring it up.
text.es: No estoy seguro/a de cómo sacar el tema.

text.en: I worry that my views would be judged or dismissed.
text.es: Me preocupa que mis opiniones sean juzgadas o descartadas.

text.en: I worry that I would be pressured to become Christian.
text.es: Me preocupa sentirme presionado/a a convertirme al cristianismo.

text.en: I am not interested in these conversations.
text.es: No me interesan estas conversaciones.

text.en: I do not know enough about Jesus or Christianity.
text.es: No sé lo suficiente sobre Jesús o el cristianismo.

text.en: I am not convinced that Christian beliefs are true.
text.es: No estoy convencido/a de que las creencias cristianas sean verdaderas.

text.es: Tengo preguntas para las que no he encontrado respuestas satisfactorias.

text.en: Some Christian teachings conflict with my views or values.
text.es: Algunas enseñanzas cristianas entran en conflicto con mis opiniones o valores.

text.es: El sufrimiento y la injusticia hacen que creer en Dios sea difícil para mí.

text.es: Seguir a Jesús no es algo en lo que haya pensado.
